phases.title: Reference Contract and Baseline Frozen
exit_criteria: 실제 implementation commit과 target anomalib commit이 고정된다.
초기 모델, category, split, metric 및 compute profile이 승인된다.
required local asset이 식별되고 silent fallback 없이 검증 가능하다.
reference raw result와 environment/protocol metadata가 연결된다.
SC-001이 해결되거나 P1을 명시적으로 차단한다.

tasks.title: Freeze implementation checkout and reconcile the specification
tasks.description: Identify the real checkout, commit, and local changes; reconcile SPEC paths and APIs without a workaround.
verification: Record commit, worktree, and component-path reconciliation.
completion_criteria: Implementation target is unambiguous and conflicts are approved or blocking.

tasks.title: Approve initial model, dataset, split, metric, and budget scope
tasks.description: Freeze initial models, MVTec scope, split, metrics, repeats, and benchmark budget.
verification: Validate completeness and consistency of all scope decisions.
completion_criteria: D-003 through D-007 and D-014 are approved.

tasks.title: Inventory local assets and dependency constraints
tasks.description: Inventory local datasets, weights, auxiliary data, checksums, formats, and package availability without downloads.
verification: Verify required/optional assets and checksums.
completion_criteria: Each required asset has a path or blocker.

tasks.title: Pin upstream source, license, and reference environment
tasks.description: Pin anomalib source/config, license, transport, and a reference-only environment.
verification: Validate commit, source closure, license, config, and environment lock.
completion_criteria: Reference identity is immutable and auditable.

tasks.title: Capture smoke fixtures and repeated reference baseline
tasks.description: Create fast fixtures and repeated raw reference results under the pinned protocol.
verification: Link outputs to config, metrics, protocol, and environment.
completion_criteria: Fixtures and repeated results are reproducible.

tasks.title: Validate baseline readiness
tasks.description: Validate baseline completeness and mark unresolved pre-implementation decisions as blocking.
verification: Run manifest, checksum, and decision checks.
completion_criteria: All P0 blockers and SC-001 are resolved.

phases.title: Minimal Anomaly Foundation Ready
exit_criteria: Approved batch/output/metric contract tests pass.
MVTec mask alignment과 split manifest가 검증된다.
Adapter/post-processing checkpoint round-trip이 새 instance에서 통과한다.
CLI와 benchmark construction semantics가 일치한다.
Common core/CLI에 anomaly model-name conditional이 없다.

tasks.title: Lock batch, output, and responsibility contracts with tests
tasks.description: Encode anomaly batch/output/metric boundaries using current adapter and registry conventions.
verification: Test normal/anomalous batches and score/map conversion.
completion_criteria: Metric inputs have no dataset-layout or model-name dependency.

tasks.title: Unify component construction and validate anomaly configuration
tasks.description: Unify CLI/benchmark construction and add fail-fast validation while preserving behavior.
verification: Compare resolved components and run invalid-config tests.
completion_criteria: Both entry paths share equivalent fail-fast construction.

tasks.title: Add adapter and post-processing state to checkpoint round-trip
tasks.description: Extend checkpoint state with adapter/calibration state, global step, schema, and protocol identity.
verification: Round-trip threshold and normalization into a new adapter.
completion_criteria: Evaluation-ready state is complete and versioned.

tasks.title: Harden MVTec data and split protocol
tasks.description: Validate MVTec parsing, masks, geometry, IDs, and materialized split semantics.
verification: Test zero/binary masks, geometry, disjointness, and shared-split flags.
completion_criteria: MVTec semantics and split are deterministic.

tasks.title: Implement approved metric and post-processing semantics
tasks.description: Implement approved metrics and protocol-ordered normalization, smoothing, and thresholds.
verification: Compare frozen metrics and serialized state.
completion_criteria: Metric semantics match approved reference inputs.

tasks.title: Enforce local asset preflight and provenance recording
tasks.description: Extend offline and strict loading with manifests, checksums, consumers, and provenance.
verification: Run missing/mismatched asset tests with network blocked.
completion_criteria: Required assets fail actionably before execution.

tasks.title: Integrate and gate the minimal foundation
tasks.description: Validate dataset-to-checkpoint-to-prediction with a fixture model and focused regressions.
verification: Run integration, state, offline fixture, and regression tests.
completion_criteria: P1 gates pass without model-name branches.

phases.title: STFPM Vertical Slice Accepted
exit_criteria: STFPM 공통 command matrix가 offline smoke에서 완료된다.
Upstream source/diff/license가 추적된다.
Student-only optimization과 reference transform이 resolved record에서 확인된다.
New-process checkpoint round-trip과 calibrated prediction이 통과한다.
Common engine에 STFPM 이름 분기가 없다.

tasks.title: Import and audit pinned STFPM pure-PyTorch source
tasks.description: Import pinned STFPM source with minimal adaptation and record checksums, license, imports, and diff.
verification: Run source audit and pure parity fixtures.
completion_criteria: Algorithm changes are minimal and approved.

tasks.title: Implement STFPM integration and reference protocol
tasks.description: Connect teacher/student outputs, loss, student-only optimization, scheduler, and transforms through the contract.
verification: Test frozen teacher, parameters, optimizer, loss, map, and protocol.
completion_criteria: STFPM follows the approved protocol.

tasks.title: Complete STFPM train and selection flow
tasks.description: Run training and validation selection with explicit leakage instrumentation.
verification: Run training smoke, selection, metrics, and split-access checks.
completion_criteria: Selection is reproducible and leakage-safe.

tasks.title: Verify STFPM checkpoint, evaluate, and predict round-trip
tasks.description: Restore STFPM in a new process and compare evaluation, prediction, and calibration state.
verification: Compare scores, maps, thresholds, and visualization inputs.
completion_criteria: New-process outputs reproduce trained state.

tasks.title: Run STFPM per-model acceptance and minimal reference comparison
tasks.description: Run STFPM command smoke and frozen reference comparison with diagnostics and provenance.
verification: Validate commands, metrics, diff, environment, and provenance.
completion_criteria: Vertical slice evidence is complete.

tasks.title: Review abstraction after the first vertical slice
tasks.description: Remove accidental STFPM responsibility from core before lifecycle generalization.
verification: Run purity and responsibility reviews.
completion_criteria: No model branch or duplicated framework remains.

phases.title: Heterogeneous Lifecycle Contract Stabilized
exit_criteria: Optimizer-none와 auxiliary lifecycle이 generic API로 실행된다.
Validation preparation과 finalize hook order가 테스트로 고정된다.
모든 lifecycle state가 checkpoint round-trip된다.
Generic engine/CLI에 EfficientAD, PatchCore 또는 anomaly model-name 분기가 없다.
P4 allowed/avoid scope와 shared-change escalation rule이 승인된다.

tasks.title: Add adapter-owned optimization specification and cadence
tasks.description: Add trainable groups, optional optimizer/scheduler, cadence, and clipping through generic boundaries.
verification: Test optimizer-present/none, parameters, and cadence.
completion_criteria: Optimization differences need no model-specific core logic.

tasks.title: Add validation preparation and finalize hook ordering
tasks.description: Add validation and finalize hook order with split-access protection.
verification: Compare hook trace and split access.
completion_criteria: Ordering is deterministic and leakage-safe.

tasks.title: Add named auxiliary loader construction and consumption
tasks.description: Build named auxiliary loaders through existing registries and expose them via loader mapping.
verification: Test missing names, restart/exhaustion, and offline assets.
completion_criteria: Only declared auxiliary loaders are consumed.

tasks.title: Complete heterogeneous lifecycle checkpoint state
tasks.description: Round-trip readiness, memory/statistics, normalization, global step, and required progress.
verification: Round-trip gradient, auxiliary, and finalize test doubles.
completion_criteria: Supported lifecycles restore explicit state.

tasks.title: Validate lifecycle capabilities without model-name branches
tasks.description: Exercise lifecycle test doubles and run purity plus existing-task regression.
verification: Run lifecycle, purity, and regression suites.
completion_criteria: Capabilities work without named branches.

tasks.title: Freeze model-wave contract and merge gate
tasks.description: Freeze model-agent scope and shared-capability escalation rules.
verification: Review allowed/avoid paths and escalation.
completion_criteria: Agents cannot independently redesign core.

phases.title: Model Lifecycle Wave 1 Accepted
exit_criteria: EfficientAD와 PatchCore workstream의 model-specific tests와 command matrix가 통과한다.
각 모델의 state가 새 process checkpoint round-trip에서 복원된다.
각 모델의 upstream source/diff/license와 asset provenance가 완전하다.
Shared core change는 P4-T03을 거쳤으며 model agent의 독자 core redesign이 없다.
STFPM 포함 세 lifecycle의 common workflow가 유지된다.

tasks.title: Integrate EfficientAD on the established contract
tasks.description: Integrate pinned EfficientAD source, auxiliary/statistics/quantile/cadence lifecycle, config, and state.
verification: Run parity, auxiliary, transform, state, offline command, and reference tests.
completion_criteria: Acceptance passes or blocks on P4-T03.

tasks.title: Integrate PatchCore on the established contract
tasks.description: Integrate pinned PatchCore source, optimizer-none collection/finalize, memory state, config, and outputs.
verification: Run parity, finalize, memory state, offline command, and reference tests.
completion_criteria: Acceptance passes or blocks on P4-T03.

tasks.title: Adjudicate shared contract change requests
tasks.description: Resolve demonstrated shared gaps centrally or record no request.
verification: Require evidence and run purity/full regression.
completion_criteria: Requests are centrally resolved or no-request is recorded.

tasks.title: Run per-model acceptance matrix
tasks.description: Apply one acceptance checklist to STFPM, EfficientAD, and PatchCore.
verification: Run smoke, round-trip, asset, reference, and provenance checks.
completion_criteria: Each model has complete acceptance evidence.

tasks.title: Freeze model integration wave
tasks.description: Audit extension cost, fidelity, licenses, and absence of duplicated framework code.
verification: Run source, purity, duplicate, license, and scope audits.
completion_criteria: Wave is merge-ready and boundaries are preserved.

phases.title: Cross-Model Reference Equivalence Proven
exit_criteria: 각 승인 모델의 reference comparison이 tolerance를 통과하거나 승인 가능한 protocol diagnosis를 남긴다.
Tolerance가 acceptance run 전에 반복 evidence로 고정된다.
Split 공유/leakage 상태가 결과에 명시된다.
한 실행 실패가 다른 결과를 삭제하거나 성공으로 오인시키지 않는다.
Fast CI profile과 long reference profile이 분리된다.

tasks.title: Implement reference manifest and protocol diff validation
tasks.description: Record and compare source, config, data, split, transforms, optimization, assets, postprocess, metrics, and environment.
verification: Inject mismatches and verify exact diffs.
completion_criteria: Protocol differences are actionable.

tasks.title: Harden benchmark isolation and result completeness
tasks.description: Preserve independent results and diagnostics when one run fails.
verification: Inject failure and inspect rows, diagnostics, and leaderboard.
completion_criteria: Failure cannot erase or mislabel other results.

tasks.title: Approve empirical tolerance and reproducibility envelope
tasks.description: Approve tolerances and repeats from pinned evidence before acceptance.
verification: Link repeats, statistics, environment, and envelope.
completion_criteria: Tolerance is frozen before P5-T04.

tasks.title: Run per-model long reference acceptance
tasks.description: Run pinned reference/integration protocols for each model and diagnose misses.
verification: Evaluate against pre-approved tolerance.
completion_criteria: Each model passes or has an explicit blocker.

tasks.title: Validate cross-model controlled benchmark
tasks.description: Produce controlled results while preserving model-specific reference protocols.
verification: Validate results, summary, protocol links, profiles, and isolation.
completion_criteria: Benchmark is reproducible and diagnosable.

phases.title: Offline, Regression, and Release Evidence Complete
exit_criteria: Offline full lifecycle and missing-asset failure matrix pass.
Existing Classification/Segmentation/Detection and benchmark regression pass.
Product runtime has no Lightning/anomalib Engine dependency or implicit download.
Upstream source/diff/license and minimal dependency audit pass.
Every in-scope acceptance criterion links to evidence; unresolved items are explicit blockers, not silent omissions.

tasks.title: Run network-blocked lifecycle and asset failure matrix
tasks.description: Run all model commands locally and verify missing/incompatible asset failures.
verification: Monitor network and run asset matrix.
completion_criteria: Local lifecycle succeeds and failures are actionable.

tasks.title: Run full existing-task and benchmark regression
tasks.description: Run Classification, Segmentation, Detection, anomaly, toy, and benchmark suites.
verification: Run full regression.
completion_criteria: Tests pass or pre-existing failures are evidenced.

tasks.title: Audit runtime purity, dependencies, source, and licenses
tasks.description: Scan forbidden imports/downloads/branches, source diffs, notices, and dependencies.
verification: Run import, download, branch, checksum, notice, and dependency scans.
completion_criteria: Runtime and source satisfy purity and attribution.

tasks.title: Assemble final acceptance and reproducibility evidence
tasks.description: Index model, integration, data, metric, reference, protocol, asset, and environment evidence.
verification: Map every acceptance criterion to evidence.
completion_criteria: No criterion lacks evidence or explicit blocker.

tasks.title: Release gate review
tasks.description: Review hierarchy, exits, non-goals, and limitations for a complete or blocked decision.
verification: Audit coverage, non-goals, and phase exits.
completion_criteria: Release is complete or explicitly blocked.
